command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=@('SH_STO_PC01','SH_Core','SH_AR','PE2','PE1','BJHQ_CSR1000V_GW_01','FW_01','Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02'); foreach(`$n in `$nodes){`$u1='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration';`$u0='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork-for-perf/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration';`$a=((Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u1 -Method Get).output -split '\r?\n')|Where-Object{`$_ -notmatch '^!Last configuration'};`$b=((Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u0 -Method Get).output -split '\r?\n')|Where-Object{`$_ -notmatch '^!Last configuration'};`$d=Compare-Object -ReferenceObject `$b -DifferenceObject `$a;if(`$d){Write-Output ('NODE='+`$n);`$d|ForEach-Object{Write-Output (`$_.SideIndicator+' '+`$_.InputObject)}}}"
